comparable_cases.case_name: Ng Wai Yip v Borich Contracting Ltd
comparable_cases.injury_description: 26 year old plaintiff sprained his left wrist... X-ray showed scaphoid fracture in his left wrist. He was hospitalised for 5 days. Whilst in hospital, reduction and screw fixation surgery to the left scaphoid was done. 6 months later, removal of the implant was performed. Thereafter he had sessions of physiotherapy and occupational therapy.

comparable_cases.case_name: Tang Bo Ling v Chan Po
comparable_cases.injury_description: a 43 year old plaintiff suffered a fracture in her left wrist, she was treated with close reduction and long arm plaster. She complained of continuous pain in her left wrist particularly when the weather changed. The movement in her left wrist was restricted and she could not lift heavy objects.

comparable_cases.case_name: Ho Chong Peng v Yue Hin Engineering Co
comparable_cases.injury_description: the 37 year old plaintiff sustained fracture distal radius in his left wrist. He was taken to hospital and an operation was performed to treat the fractured bones in his left wrist. He was discharged from hospital the following day. He experienced very considerable pain and movement of his left wrist was restricted. That pain later extended to his left arm and shoulder. He developed frozen left shoulder.
